text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu was invited as a guest
to an event at the racecourse.

Having decided to participate in the exhibition race,
she dashed gallantly across the track—
A flawless victory, just like always—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I know.
This body knows better than anyone.

Mejiro Ramonu remained silent,
as if savoring the taste of victory, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It seems my glove is fraying.
I'll need to have it mended."

"Mejiro Ramonu looked down at the glove on her left hand.
Watching her do so, a thought suddenly crossed my mind."
choice_data_list: (So it's asymmetrical on the left and right, huh?)
(So it's asymmetrical on the left and right.)

text_block_list.text: Parts of her racing outfit, such as her gloves and stockings, are asymmetrical.

It's surprising for someone who pursues perfection.
Could there be a reason why she chose an asymmetrical design?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...You've had a strange look on your face for a while now.
I decided to frankly ask the question that had just crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Eyes like a little kitten.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
What I think is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Perfect love is like a flame.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Not for a single instant does it hold the same shape.
Growing, shrinking, flickering, and blazing intensely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of that range—
that things never fall into a rut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That is why I also...
intentionally allow for some variance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
While I always feel the urge to pursue it,
I must not let myself become oversaturated...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Without stagnating or running dry—
to continue realizing a perfect love.
I'm not sure if I fully understood it, but...

I can understand the desire to create dynamic flair through asymmetry
and keep things from becoming monotonous.
choice_data_list: So that's your love for racing.
So that's your love for racing, isn't it.
Passion and bashfulness… something like that, I guess?

text_block_list.text:
I can understand the desire to create dynamic flair through asymmetry
and keep things from becoming monotonous.
choice_data_list: So that's your love for racing.
So that's your love for racing, isn't it.
Passion and bashfulness… something like that, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...You speak as if this doesn't concern you at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "I thought there would be a spark of fire inside you as well, though."

A spark, you say... Do you mean
that I must still love racing deep down?
choice_data_list: Maybe they just express love differently.
Maybe their way of showing love is just different.

text_block_list.text: It must be different from her perspective as the one actually running. I told her that watching peacefully might just be my own way of engaging with racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Your love is truly as vast as a mighty river.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Bashfulness?
You sound just like a child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Innocent love is beautiful.
...Yet, being pure alone isn't enough to understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Only by being seared, roasted, and surrendering to chaos...
can one truly feel something profound.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Only by casting aside that naive innocence...
can one reach the absolute summit.

It seems the word 'shyness' has no place in her love for racing.
I found myself thinking how truly characteristic of her that was.
